title: ReferenceBundle v1
description: Frozen app-consumer contract. It contains user-consumable guidance only: no image data, URI, path, provider metadata, credentials, keypoints, or live Pose data. Schema enforces opaque-token syntax only; producer policy separately governs how the token is generated.

pose_template.description: Textual reference-derived pose intent only. It is not a keypoint set, skeleton coordinate payload, biometric result, or Pose-provider output.

version.description: Frozen payload version. Unknown versions must be rejected rather than guessed or partially rendered.

opaqueId.description: SCHEMA_ENFORCED: opaque token syntax only; no URI, path, email, whitespace, colon, slash, or backslash syntax. PRODUCER_POLICY_ONLY: generate it from an approved random/opaque generator, never directly from an account, device, location, file name, URI, or media hash.

plainText240.description: Plain single-line text with at least one non-whitespace character. Semantic validation additionally rejects leading or trailing whitespace without silently normalizing provider output.
